text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Alas, what a disaster! The 'Holy Scripture' for studying life in the Otherworld...
could it truly be lost forever...?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...No! This, too, must be a trial to reach "that land"!
I shall find it without fail!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: After all—I am the Saint who shall save "that land"!
choice_data_list: Hey, Desire. What are you doing?
Hi, Desire. What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good day, Trainer.
Truth be told, I am searching for a book.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I have located 'The Medieval Carrot Compendium' and 'Castles of the Ancient World',
but for some reason, the 'Encyclopedia of Umamusume Legends' is nowhere to be found.
choice_data_list: Want me to help you look for it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No, pay it no mind. Through the power of the Saint, I shall track it down.
The mana of that tome is—gasp! I sense it, from that bookshelf over there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after becoming Red Desire's Trainer.
Seeing her everyday life made me realize once again just how real her yearning for the 'Otherworld' was.

text_block_list.name: Beautification Committee Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Sure, it's not impossible to grow swertia and bitter grass at home.
But they're really, really bitter, you know?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, worry not. When concocting them,
I shall use my sacred power to craft a delicious potion!

text_block_list.name: Beautification Committee Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... If you say so...?

text_block_list.name: Desire's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Desire-san, what language are you writing in that notebook?
I've never seen those letters before.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, runes, of course♪ As a Saint, reading and writing mystical scripts
is a basic discipline. ...Oh dear, what did this character mean again?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Finished Cleaning
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, seriously! I'm trying to put the mop away and it won't open!
Everyone just jams stuff in however they want!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Hark, troubled maiden.
The Saint of Salvation has descended upon this very place.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This tightly sealed door...
I shall unlock it with the power of the Saint.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Finished Cleaning
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Uhh... you mean you'll do it for me?
Ah, I'm actually in a hurry, so that saves me! Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway,
I spotted Red Desire locked in fierce combat with a cleaning locker.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Hup! ............Phew. It won't budge easily.
—Gasp! Could this also be a... trial bestowed upon the Saint?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
It appears we are being thwarted.
By the workings of a grand destiny, the "liberation" of that locker is...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, fear not. I shall overcome this trial.
As the Holy Maiden destined to reach "that realm"—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hngh! Yah! Mmmghhh~~...!!
—Ah!! Praise be, it opened!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLATTER CRASH—!!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Eeeek?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Owwieee...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes... It was merely a falling broom that struck me... Oh?
choice_data_list: Oh no! Your nose is bleeding!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, she wasn't seriously hurt,
and the nosebleed stopped quickly with some basic first aid.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...Even so, it has turned into quite a mess, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And yet—fufu. This only proves it once more.
That I have been summoned from an alternate world as a Holy Maiden.
choice_data_list: What do you mean, proves it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The falling broom, the scattered tools—...
All of it is a "trial" bestowed upon this Holy Maiden!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Thou shalt not falter at such trifles"—
That is the divine message being conveyed to me!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes! No matter the hardship, I shall never fall to my knees!
I will overcome this trial without fail!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: For I am—the Holy Maiden chosen by destiny!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—First, let us move the long-handled items to the side.
And place the lighter things on the bottom, correct?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing Red Desire tackle every misfortune positively as a "trial,"
I can't help but admire her unbreakable spirit.
choice_data_list: I'll help you clean up the locker.
I'll help you clean up the locker.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My...! You will walk this trial with me!
Then, first—could you pick up that mop over there?
